latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Counterpart Style Profiler skill.

- Enables users to profile a negotiation counterpart’s communication archetype (Analyst, Accommodator, Assertive) using observable behavioral signals.
- Generates a tailored adaptation strategy covering communication tempo, information style, relationship approach, and risk areas.
- Works from conversation histories, emails, meeting notes, colleague descriptions, or situation briefs.
- Flags the user's own style to warn about projection risks in analysis.
- Designed for anyone negotiating—no formal training needed; supports sales, management, consulting, recruitment, freelance, and more.
